newsitem.title: USA: Trikon sees Q1 loss due to off industry.
newsitem.headline: Trikon sees Q1 loss due to off industry.

text.p: Trikon Technologies Inc said Friday it expects to post a significant loss in the first quarter because of a downturn in the semiconductor industry.

The company, which provides a line of advanced manufacturing systems used in the manufacturing of semiconductors, said it also expects first quarter sales to be lower than they were in the fourth quarter.

The company said the current weakness in demand in the semiconductor industry, and any continuation of this weakness in the future, is likely to materially and adversely affect its business and operations.
Trikon said it believes the downturn will continue through at least the third quarter of 1997.
The company could not be reached for comment, and its results from its fourth quarter and the prior year's first quarter were not immediately available.
